title: Fill the balloons
rule: Every balloon is empty; the four lines wait in the margin as cut-out slips with tabs to place.
made: six panels drawn entirely in the shared HANDMADE pen line (penlib.brush_line via build_page03.pen) on the LoC 1934 sheet: the agent (hair, glasses, collar and tie, waistcoat with three buttons, shirt sleeves, pencil), the stranger (hat with band, coat with collar and buttons) behind the glazed ticket window lettered TICKET OFFICE, desk, memo slip with the canon text, wall clock (4:09 at the desk, 4:10 at the answer), cupboard hinged on the left jamb with the key on its hook and its SERVICE tag, SERVICE door
four balloons drawn EMPTY in pen with their tails to the speakers; each balloon outline is computed from its own line in the pen hand (same size and wobble as its slip)

the four canon lines lettered in the shared pen hand on four cut-out slips in the outer margin, shuffled (thanks, forgetting, question, answer): the same outline as the balloon, a dashed scissor line, a hatched paste tab on a dotted fold, a small pen scissors
hand-ruled borders (penlib.border_mask); folio '18 / Fill the balloons' (pen99.folio)
beats: each slip cut out (its hole left in the margin) and pasted into its balloon as a paper piece with one shadow

events.E0: panel 1: the agent behind his desk, the memo '4:15 - open SERVICE door. Key in cupboard.' on it, clock at 4:09
events.E1: panel 2: walking past the ticket window; the stranger behind the glass; empty balloon tailed to her
events.E2: panel 3: he turns to the wall clock (4:10); empty balloon tailed to him
events.E3: panel 4: she turns away; empty balloon tailed to her; he walks on
events.E4: panel 5: he swings the cupboard door open on its left jamb; key on its hook with the SERVICE tag
events.E5: panel 6: pencil to his chin before the open cupboard; empty balloon tailed to him; SERVICE door shut

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

beat: the slips are cut out of the margin one by one and pasted into their balloons: question, answer, thanks, forgetting
beat_frames: b01: the page: four empty balloons, the four slips waiting in the margin
b02: the question slip cut out along its scissor line and carried toward panel 2
b03: the question pasted into its balloon (panel 2, tail to the stranger)
b04: + the answer pasted (panel 3, tail to the agent under the clock)
b05: + the thanks pasted (panel 4, tail to the stranger turning away)
b06: + the forgetting pasted (panel 6, tail to the agent at the cupboard); the margin holds only the cut-out holes

self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker

weaknesses: figures are a simple diagrammatic pen line, stiffer than the shared brush hand's lettering; the agent's pencil-to-chin hand crosses his face in panel 6
matching is by shape and sense: the answer and forgetting balloons are both two-line ovals of similar width, told apart mainly by size and by their speaker
panel 3 drops the ticket window from shot (he turns to the clock); the stranger is implied off-panel
